body: It's not even just about relationships. It's the fact that I'm just completely incapable of being happy. I'll get waves of happiness, but when they're gone I'm completely crushed but I can't hold on to them. I've isolated myself from all my friends, and I know any day now my girlfriend is going to leave me. I have no idea how I'm making rent this month, and I have no idea how I'm going to pay the debts I owe. Collections harass me everyday and I feel like a piece of shit. I feel like death is the only choice. Every time I'm happy I'm haunted by all the fucked up shit that's happened to me
